description: Report a bug, feedback or a feature request to the 765T Flow team. Call this tool only when the user asks you to report something or agrees a report should be sent — never on your own initiative. The `message` is the report; never include project data, model content, file paths or secrets. The answer returns the `reportId` reference the team tracks the report by.

context.description: Optional typed context for triage — the closed member set below; no free-form fields.

message.description: The report text — what happened, or what you suggest. Never project data, model content, file paths or secrets.

name: flow_report_issue
title: Report an issue
